name: landsight-film
description: Landsight demo film: director-scene captures from the running app, paper beats, captions and sound, cut in Remotion to SCRIPT.md v4.

scripts.render: node prepare.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts Film landsight-v1.mp4 --codec h264 --audio-codec aac
scripts.render:alice: node prepare.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts Film landsight-v1-alice.mp4 --codec h264 --audio-codec aac --props '{"narrator":"alice"}'
scripts.render:scene1: node scene1-prepare.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts Scene1Tree scene1-prototype-v2.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --audio-codec aac
scripts.render:scene2: node scene2-prepare.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts Scene2Folder scene2-prototype.mp4 --codec h264 --audio-codec aac
scripts.render:scene4: node scene4-prepare.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts Scene4Tower scene4-prototype.mp4 --codec h264 --audio-codec aac
scripts.render:opening: node scene1-prepare.mjs && node scene2-prepare.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts OpeningV6 opening-v6-prototype-v2.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --audio-codec aac
scripts.render:v7: node story-v7-prepare.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts StoryV7 story-v7-preview.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --audio-codec aac --gl=angle
scripts.render:animatic: node animatic-v7-prepare.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts AnimaticV7 animatic-v7.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 23 --audio-codec aac
scripts.render:animatic8: remotion render src/index.ts AnimaticV8 animatic-v8.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 23 --gl=angle
